entries.gpa: Taught master’s baseline (excluding EMBA): recognized bachelor’s degree, normally at least second-class honours or average grade B; approved equivalent qualifications may be considered.
entries.english: Unless exempt: IELTS Academic 6.5; TOEFL iBT 79/120 or 4.5/6. The official page also lists alternative qualifications and programme-specific conditions.
entries.notes: Some programmes have higher academic or English requirements. Tests normally remain valid for two years.

entries.gpa: Standalone doctoral routes normally require a recognized master’s degree, with specified alternative routes. The PhD stream of MPhil–PhD programmes also admits eligible bachelor’s degree holders, normally second-class honours or average B.
entries.english: Unless exempt: IELTS Academic 6.5; TOEFL iBT 79/120 or 4.5/6, with other alternatives listed by CUHK.
entries.notes: Standalone PhD and the PhD stream of MPhil–PhD programmes have different eligibility routes; do not treat them as identical.

entries.english: If the prior institution’s instruction/examination was not English: TOEFL 85 before 21 January 2026 or 4.5 on/after; alternatively IELTS Academic 6.5 with all components 6.0. Faculty of Arts generally requires IELTS 7.0 with components 6.0, with stated exceptions.
entries.notes: MPhil/PhD research admissions source, not taught-master’s policy. Arts TOEFL Writing requirements are higher. TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS One Skill Retake are not accepted.

entries.gpa: A recognized bachelor’s degree or a qualification accepted as equivalent; final-year applicants may apply before obtaining the degree.
entries.english: If prior instruction was not English: IELTS 6.0; TOEFL iBT 79 before 21 January 2026 or 4.0 on/after. Other accepted qualifications are listed by CityUHK. Individual schools may set higher requirements.
entries.notes: IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 4.0 may trigger an English interview, subject to the published exception. Home Edition, MyBest, IELTS Online/Indicator and One Skill Retake are not accepted.

entries.gpa: Recognized bachelor’s degree or an individually accepted equivalent; additional programme conditions apply.
entries.english: For non-native speakers whose prior degree was not taught in English: IELTS Academic 6.0; TOEFL iBT 80/120 or 4.5/6 under the new scale. Results must be from a single sitting within two years.
entries.deadline: Individual programme deadlines; applications may be considered on a rolling basis until places are filled.
entries.notes: This source is for taught postgraduate admissions. TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS Online/Indicator/One Skill Retake are not accepted.

entries.english: Course-dependent levels: Standard IELTS 6.5 (each component 6.0), Higher IELTS 7.0 (each 6.5). TOEFL before 21 January 2026: Standard 92 (each 20), Higher 100 (each 22); from that date: Standard 4.5 (each 4.5), Higher 5.0 (each 5.0).
entries.notes: The individual course specifies Standard or Higher. Accepted alternatives and exemptions are listed on the source page; these are language standards, not universal academic entry requirements.

entries.english: Course-dependent levels: Standard IELTS 6.5 (each component 6.0), Higher IELTS 7.0 (each 6.5). TOEFL before 21 January 2026: Standard 92 (each 20), Higher 100 (each 22); from that date: Standard 4.5 (each 4.5), Higher 5.0 (each 5.0).
entries.notes: The individual course specifies Standard or Higher. Accepted alternatives and exemptions are listed on the source page; these are language standards, not universal academic entry requirements.

entries.notes: The individual course specifies Standard or Higher. Accepted alternatives and exemptions are listed on the source page; these are language standards, not universal academic entry requirements.

entries.gpa: Recognized bachelor’s degree or equivalent; normally a minimum GPA of 3.0/B on a 4.0 scale, plus adequate preparation for the intended graduate field.
entries.english: TOEFL or IELTS is required unless the published exemption applies; individual programme conditions must also be checked.
entries.documents: Academic records and recommendation letters; statement of purpose and personal-history statement. Other tests depend on the programme.
entries.intake: Graduate application source explicitly covers Fall 2027.

entries.gpa: Recognized bachelor’s degree or equivalent; normally a minimum GPA of 3.0/B on a 4.0 scale, plus adequate preparation for the intended graduate field.

entries.documents: Academic records and recommendation letters; statement of purpose and personal-history statement. Other tests depend on the programme.
entries.intake: Graduate application source explicitly covers Fall 2027.

entries.gpa: Appropriate recognized bachelor’s degree or equivalent with at least a mid-B average in the final year. Graduate units may set higher requirements.
entries.deadline: Varies by graduate programme.
entries.notes: International degree equivalencies and language-test rules must be checked separately; meeting the SGS minimum does not guarantee admission.

entries.gpa: Appropriate master’s degree or equivalent with at least B+ average, or comparable demonstrated research competence. Some departments offer direct entry from a bachelor’s degree to exceptional candidates, minimum A− average.
entries.deadline: Varies by graduate programme.
entries.notes: The direct-entry route is department-specific; it is not available automatically in every programme.

entries.gpa: Minimum 3.00 GPA over the equivalent of the last 60 undergraduate semester hours, or a master’s cumulative GPA of 3.00. International academic records are assessed on their own grading scale; do not self-convert.
entries.english: Unless exempt: TOEFL 92 before 21 January 2026 or 5.0 on/after; IELTS 7.0. Other accepted tests and programme-specific conditions are on the official source.
entries.notes: A comparable bachelor’s degree must be completed before graduate enrollment. Departments may set stricter requirements.

entries.gpa: Minimum 3.00 GPA over the equivalent of the last 60 undergraduate semester hours, or a master’s cumulative GPA of 3.00. International academic records are assessed on their own grading scale; do not self-convert.
entries.english: Unless exempt: TOEFL 92 before 21 January 2026 or 5.0 on/after; IELTS 7.0. Other accepted tests and programme-specific conditions are on the official source.
entries.notes: A comparable bachelor’s degree must be completed before graduate enrollment. Departments may set stricter requirements.

entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.0 with each component 6.5. TOEFL before 21 January 2026: overall 100, R22/W21/S21/L22; from that date: overall 5.0, R4.5/W4.5/S4.0/L5.0. DET 130 with the published subscores is also accepted.
entries.documents: Transcripts from all post-secondary institutions and three references; check the programme page for additional application materials.
entries.notes: The programme states that GRE is not required. Country-specific degree eligibility and competitive academic expectations must also be checked.

entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.0 with each component 6.5. TOEFL before 21 January 2026: overall 100, R22/W21/S21/L22; from that date: overall 5.0, R4.5/W4.5/S4.0/L5.0. DET 130 with the published subscores is also accepted.
entries.documents: Transcripts from all post-secondary institutions and three references; check the programme page for additional application materials.
entries.notes: The programme states that GRE is not required. Country-specific degree eligibility and competitive academic expectations must also be checked.

entries.gpa: First-class or strong upper-second four-year honours degree in a relevant subject; alternatively a qualifying three-year honours degree plus a master’s with merit/distinction. Normally GPA 3.5/4.0 for a US undergraduate qualification.
entries.english: Standard level: IELTS Academic 7.0 with each component 6.5. The source lists TOEFL 100 and component minima for the old test, but says tests taken from 21 January 2026 are not accepted pending review of the revised test.
entries.notes: Do not apply the US GPA conversion to qualifications from other countries. GRE/GMAT scores are not sought. Check the source again before choosing a TOEFL test date.

entries.gpa: UK first-class degree or equivalent in a subject without substantial computing content, plus good A-level Mathematics or equivalent.
entries.english: Higher level: IELTS Academic 7.0 with each component 6.5, or another accepted Higher-level qualification.
entries.notes: This is a conversion MSc intended for graduates of non-computing subjects; it must not be confused with Imperial’s Advanced Computing MSc.

entries.deadline: Restrictive Early Action: 1 November; Regular Decision: 1 January. Confirm the entry year on the admissions page.
entries.documents: Application; school report including counselor letter and high-school transcript; two teacher recommendations; midyear report. Final school report is for admitted students.

Two recent core-academic teacher recommendations; academic records and school report through the selected application platform; self-reported ACT/SAT per the published testing policy. Non-native speakers from non-English-medium secondary schools also submit English test results.
entries.notes: Check the linked testing policy and applicant category. No English score threshold is inferred from this overview.

entries.documents: Common Application with Princeton-specific questions; fee or waiver; school report and counselor recommendation; two teacher recommendations from different core academic areas; transcript and midyear report. Check the full checklist for additional items.

entries.deadline: Early Decision: 1 November 2026; Regular Decision: 5 January 2027.
entries.documents: Apply through the Common App, Coalition App or QuestBridge; select one of Penn’s four undergraduate schools or an eligible coordinated dual-degree programme.

entries.deadline: ED application: 1 November; other required materials: 13 November. RD application: 2 January; other required materials: 19 January. Confirm the entry cycle on the source.
entries.documents: Application and Cornell supplement; counselor recommendation and two teacher recommendations; academic records; portfolio/design supplement only if required by the intended programme.
entries.notes: Financial-aid deadlines differ by applicant category and are not the same as the application-materials deadlines.

entries.documents: Common Application or Coalition on Scoir; official high-school transcripts; counselor recommendation and school profile; midyear report; two academic teacher recommendations. For Engineering, one teacher must be in math or science.

entries.notes: The page gives typical-cycle dates as well as current-cycle announcements; check the exact current deadline before submitting.

entries.documents: ACT/SAT scores are optional under the published first-year/transfer testing policy; applicants choosing to submit scores should follow Northwestern’s self-reporting and superscoring guidance.
entries.notes: This summary reviews the testing policy only. School-specific supplements and the rest of the application checklist must also be checked.

entries.deadline: Early Decision: 1 November; Regular Decision: 5 January, at 11:59 p.m. applicant local time. Confirm the entry cycle on the source.

entries.notes: PLME and Brown–RISD applicants have additional requirements; Brown does not publish a minimum standardized-test score on this checklist.

entries.documents: Application; high-school transcript; secondary school report and counselor recommendation; two teacher recommendations. SAT/ACT submission is optional under the published 2026–27 cycle policy.

entries.gpa: Non-California residents, including international applicants: at least 3.4 in the UC-defined 10th/11th-grade A–G courses, with no grade below C. This is not an unrestricted cumulative GPA calculation.
entries.english: Where required: IELTS 7.0 or DET 115. The page also gives TOEFL requirements differentiated by the January 2026 test change; check that exact table before submitting a TOEFL result.
entries.documents: UC application, UC A–G subject preparation and personal-insight responses. SAT/ACT scores are not considered for admission or scholarship selection.

entries.deadline: Autumn first-year applications: 15 November under the published schedule; confirm the entry year. UW does not use Early Action or Early Decision.
entries.english: International first-year applicants submit an official TOEFL or IELTS result meeting the linked UW English requirement; no score cutoff is inferred from this overview.
entries.notes: The winter first-year route is not open to international applicants.

entries.documents: Application; two recommendations (one counselor and one teacher); official high-school transcripts and college transcripts where applicable. English evidence and international academic documents depend on applicant category.
entries.notes: The page describes competitive A−/B+ preparation; this is not converted into an invented minimum GPA.

entries.documents: Common Application or QuestBridge; high-school transcript and senior grades; counselor recommendation and school report; teacher evaluation. Standardized testing is optional on this overview; College of Fine Arts has extra requirements.

Application; official high-school and college transcripts; one counselor or teacher recommendation (some programmes require more); fall grades when available. Portfolios, résumés, writing samples or auditions are major-specific.
entries.notes: EA/ED participation and regular-decision deadlines differ for performing arts and World Bachelor in Business. Check the programme-specific plan before applying.

entries.gpa: First-class honours degree or equivalent in computer science; a comparably strong numerate degree may be considered with substantial relevant preparation. A-level-equivalent mathematics and programming experience are presumed.
entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with every component at least 7.0. The page also lists a legacy-scale TOEFL requirement; confirm the currently accepted test version and do not infer a new-scale conversion.
entries.notes: The course funding deadline is 8 December 2026 and is earlier than the final course-application deadline. Courses may close early.

entries.gpa: First-class honours degree or equivalent; a master’s degree or other postgraduate work is highly desirable, not stated as universally mandatory.
entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with every component at least 7.0. The page also lists a legacy-scale TOEFL requirement; confirm the currently accepted test version and do not infer a new-scale conversion.
entries.deadline: Michaelmas 2027: 13 May 2027. Course funding: 8 December 2026. Other entry terms have separate deadlines.
entries.notes: The course funding deadline is 8 December 2026 and is earlier than the final course-application deadline. Courses may close early.

entries.gpa: First-class honours degree or equivalent with significant finance, economics or quantitative content. Normally no more than one year of post-graduation work experience, excluding internships/vacation employment.
entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with every component at least 7.0. The page also lists a legacy-scale TOEFL requirement; confirm the currently accepted test version and do not infer a new-scale conversion.
entries.notes: The course funding deadline is 8 December 2026 and is earlier than the final course-application deadline. Courses may close early.

entries.gpa: High upper second-class degree or international equivalent in Economics, including intermediate microeconomics, macroeconomics and econometrics. Business/accountancy/management degrees alone do not provide the required background.
entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with every component at least 7.0. The page also lists a legacy-scale TOEFL requirement; confirm the currently accepted test version and do not infer a new-scale conversion.
entries.notes: The course funding deadline is 8 December 2026 and is earlier than the final course-application deadline. Courses may close early.

entries.gpa: At least UK upper second-class bachelor’s or equivalent in a subject other than computer science/information technology, including their subfields. Evidence of A-level-standard mathematics, analytical skills and computational thinking is required.
entries.deadline: Applicants requiring a visa: 22 March 2027, 17:00 UK time. Applicants not requiring a visa: 27 August 2027; the closing time differs by course, so check its source page.
entries.notes: Applications open 19 October 2026. The Computer Science MSc is a conversion course; it is not intended for CS/IT graduates.

entries.gpa: At least UK upper second-class bachelor’s or equivalent in a quantitative discipline. University-level mathematical methods and linear algebra, introductory probability/statistics, and high-level programming experience such as R, MATLAB or Python are expected.
entries.deadline: Applicants requiring a visa: 22 March 2027, 17:00 UK time. Applicants not requiring a visa: 27 August 2027; the closing time differs by course, so check its source page.
entries.notes: Applications open 19 October 2026. Programme-specific entry standards are separate from UCL’s university-wide language policy.

entries.gpa: First-class honours degree or equivalent in computer science or mathematics. For a US bachelor’s qualification, normally at least 3.7/4.0 overall; use Oxford’s country equivalency guidance for other countries.
entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.5 with each component 7.0. The page lists old-scale TOEFL 110 with component thresholds but says tests from 21 January 2026 are not accepted pending review of the revised test.
entries.notes: No GRE or GMAT scores are sought. Check current acceptance of the revised TOEFL before booking a test.

entries.english: TOEFL iBT at least 100/120 or 5.0/6; IELTS at least 6.5; or qualifying certification of English-medium instruction.
entries.documents: CV; identity/passport documents; degree certificate and transcripts (with English versions where required); English evidence; GPA and reason for pursuing the programme in the application. GRE and reference letters are optional.
entries.notes: The academic eligibility has separate degree/experience routes in the official programme page; do not infer a universal GPA minimum.

entries.deadline: Early application: 18 November 2026 at 15:00 EST; final application: 9 December 2026 at 15:00 EST.
entries.documents: Statement of purpose; transcripts; three recommendations, with at least two from faculty or recent employers; English-language evidence under SCS policy. GRE is strongly recommended under the current programme guidance.
entries.notes: Admission is for fall only. Language waivers are not issued by the CS Department for non-native English speakers; consult SCS’s policy.

entries.deadline: Early application: 18 November 2026 at 15:00 EST; final application: 9 December 2026 at 15:00 EST.
entries.documents: Complete online application and required supporting documents, including recommendation letters, required test scores and unofficial transcripts, must arrive by the final deadline.
entries.notes: The CS Department is one of several separate doctoral programmes in SCS. Select the intended programme and consult its full requirements.

entries.deadline: 15 December for fall admission under the published recurring schedule; confirm the entry year.
entries.documents: Scanned academic transcripts for all previous college/university work; certified English translations where required; other supporting materials and English results specified on the programme page.
entries.notes: Applicants intending a PhD should apply directly to the PhD programme, whether their prior degree is bachelor’s or master’s. No score threshold is inferred from this summary.

entries.gpa: For the published no-work-experience stream: bachelor’s degree in any discipline, at least 65% WAM or equivalent, and at least one tertiary computer-programming subject.
entries.english: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with each component 6.0; other accepted tests and component minima are listed on the source.
entries.notes: The 65% requirement is an Australian WAM/equivalent, not a fabricated 4-point GPA conversion. Check the appropriate stream and eligibility; meeting the minimum does not guarantee selection.

entries.gpa: Australian bachelor’s degree in any discipline with a credit average of 65%, or an equivalent qualification.
entries.notes: The page separates academic admission from English evidence; no unverified English cutoff is filled in.

entries.english: MFin does not require an English proficiency examination and does not accept TOEFL/IELTS scores. English ability is assessed in the interview.
entries.deadline: 5 January 2027 at 15:00 Eastern Time.
entries.documents: Academic records; three recommendation letters under the current-student/working-professional categories; application statements and video components. GMAT/GRE is optional and encouraged if available.
entries.notes: Programme-specific policy: do not substitute the central OGE English-test guidance for the MFin policy.

entries.deadline: Round 1: 29 September 2026 (past); Round 2: 12 January 2027. Applications are due at 15:00 Eastern Time.
entries.documents: Valid GMAT or GRE score is required; academic records; recommendation/reference components and the application’s written/video materials. Check the full checklist for each component.
entries.notes: The MBA requires GMAT/GRE, while the indexed MFin treats it as optional. These are separate programme policies.

entries.documents: Transcripts; GMAT or GRE; English-language test where applicable; essays; recommendations; résumé; application fee or waiver. An invitation-only interview and post-interview reflection are later stages.
entries.notes: HBS MBA policy is separate from Harvard Griffin GSAS. No GSAS English cutoff is copied into the MBA record.

entries.gpa: First-class honours degree is preferred; upper second-class honours or equivalent is also considered. A highly quantitative discipline such as mathematics, engineering, economics, finance or science is expected.
entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.0 with each component 6.5; TOEFL before 21 January 2026: 100 with each component 22; revised TOEFL: 5.0 with each component 5.0. DET 125 overall with no band below 115 is also listed.
entries.notes: A strong GMAT/GRE may strengthen the application, but GMAT is not required. Course-specific quantitative preparation matters.

entries.gpa: Recognized bachelor’s degree with at least second-class honours or average grade B, or an equivalent professional qualification.
entries.deadline: 2027–28 admission: full-time 31 March 2027; part-time 30 April 2027. Rolling review; may close early when full.
entries.notes: GMAT/GRE is not mandatory for full-time applicants but a good result strengthens the application. Part-time applicants preferably have two years of post-qualification work experience. Graduation/probation GPAs on the same page are not admission cutoffs.

entries.gpa: Recognized three- or four-year bachelor’s degree with a B+ average or equivalent; acceptance of a three-year degree depends on the country/region.
entries.english: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 or PTE Academic 70 are among the accepted options; test validity and exemptions follow Sauder’s published rules.
entries.notes: Meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission. GMAT/GRE, work experience and other holistic criteria must also be checked on the programme page.

entries.english: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall with every component at least 7.0; other accepted tests and component requirements are listed on the source.
entries.intake: The source states these published entry requirements apply from the 2027 intake onwards.
entries.notes: Academic selection and pathway rules must also be checked. No general WAM or LSAT requirement is inferred from the language-test section.

entries.gpa: A recognized US bachelor’s degree or international equivalent must be completed before enrollment. No specific undergraduate coursework or Computer Science degree is required, but strong quantitative and analytical skills are expected.
entries.notes: The department page links to separate application checklist and deadline pages. Admission to the MS is not a guaranteed route into Stanford’s PhD programme.

entries.gpa: A recognized US bachelor’s degree or international equivalent must be completed before enrollment. No specific undergraduate coursework or Computer Science degree is required, but strong quantitative and analytical skills are expected.
entries.notes: The department page links to separate application checklist and deadline pages. Research-oriented doctoral programme; consult the department checklist for the complete application.

entries.gpa: Good honours degree or equivalent in any discipline. Designed for applicants with non-computing degrees; preference is given to applicants with IT-related work experience.
entries.english: If the prior university’s main medium of instruction was not English: TOEFL iBT 90 (legacy scale) or 4.5 (new scale), or IELTS 6.0. TOEFL/IELTS scores are valid for two years.
entries.documents: Submit GRE or GMAT scores: GRE verbal + quantitative at least 320 and analytical writing at least 3.5, or GMAT at least 650 as published on the source. Graduates of Indian universities may submit GATE instead.
entries.notes: GRE/GMAT scores are valid for five years. The source does not identify a GMAT Focus equivalent; no conversion is inferred. Admission is competitive even when minima are met.

entries.gpa: Good relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree. Research scholarship applicants normally need at least second-class upper honours or equivalent in Computing or a related discipline, and ability to pursue the proposed research.
entries.english: International applicants whose prior university did not use English as the main medium of communication must submit TOEFL iBT at least 90 (legacy scale) or IELTS at least 6.0. The page does not publish a new TOEFL-scale threshold.
entries.documents: Recommendations from two academic referees. GRE is not required but is encouraged; graduates of Indian universities may submit GATE instead.
entries.notes: Research scholarship applicants may be interviewed. Check the linked application information for cycle-specific deadlines.

entries.deadline: Main round: 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong time. Clearing round: 30 April 2027 at 12:00 noon Hong Kong time.
entries.documents: Upload academic qualifications and transcripts with grading systems; proof of CGPA or average grade; class rank if available; CV; identity and applicable visa documents. English test evidence is required where the prior institution’s language of instruction and examination was not English.
entries.notes: The page links to University Entrance Requirements and English Language Requirements separately; no numeric GPA or English minimum is inferred from those links. Originals may be required after an offer.

entries.gpa: Required preparation includes four years of mathematics including calculus, one year each of physics and chemistry, four years of English and two years of history/social sciences. Biology is recommended. International qualification and course-substitution rules apply.
entries.english: Unless exempt: IELTS 7.0 overall and in every section; TOEFL before 21 January 2026: 100 overall and 25 each; TOEFL on/after 21 January 2026: 5 overall and 5 each; Duolingo 130 overall and in each area. Take the test before the application deadline.
entries.deadline: 2027 entry: Restrictive Early Action 1 November 2026; Regular Decision 4 January 2027.
entries.documents: Common Application or QuestBridge application; required SAT or ACT; school report and official transcript; two teacher recommendations (one STEM and one humanities/social sciences); midyear report; fee or waiver. Non-English transcripts need an English translation.
entries.notes: English-medium schooling alone is not automatically an English-test exemption. Check the published native-language and language-of-instruction conditions. InitialView is recommended, not mandatory.

entries.gpa: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent must be completed before graduate study. Caltech publishes no minimum GPA or other single quantitative cutoff; applications are reviewed holistically.
entries.documents: Transcripts from every college/university attended, three recommendation letters, CV and application essays. GRE policy is set by the individual graduate option.
entries.notes: The bachelor’s-degree prerequisite is stated in the linked application checklist. Applicants already holding a PhD are not considered for a second PhD. Apply to one academic option per cycle.

entries.gpa: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent must be completed before graduate study. Caltech publishes no minimum GPA or other single quantitative cutoff; applications are reviewed holistically.
entries.documents: Transcripts from every college/university attended, three recommendation letters, CV and application essays. GRE policy is set by the individual graduate option.
entries.notes: The bachelor’s-degree prerequisite is stated in the linked application checklist. Applicants already holding a PhD are not considered for a second PhD. Apply to one academic option per cycle.

entries.english: Normal admission standard: IELTS Academic 7.5 overall, usually 7.0 in each component; Cambridge C2 Proficiency 200 overall with 185 each, or C1 Advanced 193 with 185 each plus other evidence of competence. Accepted school-leaving qualifications may demonstrate C1 English instead.
entries.notes: The lower IELTS 6.5/6.0 interview-readiness guidance is not the admission requirement. Academic offer levels and required subjects are specific to the course and College.

entries.gpa: A-level minimum A*A*A (three subjects) or A*AAA (four), with A* Mathematics; Further Mathematics preferred. IB minimum 41 with HL Mathematics 7 and another relevant HL subject 7. Typical offers are higher and are not minimum requirements.
entries.deadline: 13 January 2027 at 18:00 UK time, via UCAS (G400; institution I50).
entries.documents: UCAS application with academic record and supporting information. TMUA is mandatory for 2027 entry; MAT is no longer used. Interviews are discretionary rather than standard for every applicant.

entries.gpa: Normally a good 2:1 law qualification (LLB, JD or GDL), averaging at least 65% across all years with at least one first-class mark. Applicants below 62% are not normally considered. Non-law first degrees and exceptional relevant-work-experience routes have separate criteria.
entries.english: UCL English Language Level 4. Use the linked university English-language evidence policy for accepted qualifications and test equivalents.
entries.deadline: September 2027 entry: visa applicants 25 June 2027; applicants not requiring a visa 27 August 2027. Both deadlines are 17:00 UK time. The page also contains a conflicting closed-application notice; verify live portal availability before paying.
entries.documents: Application and academic evidence; personal statement addressing the published selection criteria; 750-word written work on a contemporary legal topic; one reference. Online application fee: GBP 90.
entries.notes: Country equivalencies do not automatically replace the course’s specified 65% threshold. LLM specialisms are selected after enrolment; they are not separate application routes.

entries.gpa: Minimum GPA 3.0; technical preparation equivalent to a computer-science bachelor’s, including programming, algorithms, data structures, systems, AI and theory. A CS degree itself is not mandatory. The published admitted-student average of 3.7 is not the minimum.
entries.english: TOEFL or IELTS evidence is required unless the Graduate Division’s published exemption applies. Duolingo, TOEFL ITP, MyBest Scores, IELTS Indicator and IELTS One Test Retake are not accepted.
entries.deadline: 6 January 2027 at 20:59 Pacific Standard Time; application and supplemental materials.

entries.gpa: Recognized bachelor’s degree or equivalent. Minimum GPA 3.0/B for institutions using the 4.0 scale; applicants on other scales must not convert their grades to 4.0.
entries.english: TOEFL or IELTS evidence is required unless a published Graduate Division exemption applies; programme and university English-language policies both apply.
entries.deadline: 1 December 2026 at 20:59 Pacific Standard Time for Fall 2027 admission.
entries.documents: Three recommendation letters uploaded by referees, statement of purpose, personal-history statement, CV and academic records. GRE scores are neither required nor accepted.
entries.notes: The research MS/PhD route differs from MEng. MS-only admission is mainly for current Berkeley PhD students; occasional external admission is exceptional and typically fewer than ten places.

entries.gpa: Appropriate bachelor’s degree in CS or a related discipline; final-year minimum B+ (U of T 77–79% or 3.3/4.0). International applicants are not considered for this MSc and are directed to MScAC or direct-entry PhD.
entries.english: University English-language proficiency requirements apply. Applicants without a CS degree need substantial CS experience and university mathematics, algorithms and computer-systems preparation.
entries.deadline: 1 December 2026 for Fall 2027 entry. The department states this is a firm deadline, including for Vector Institute applicants.
entries.documents: Three references (at least two addressing graduate research ability), statement of purpose of at most two single-spaced pages, CV, research interests and academic transcripts. Unofficial copies may be used to apply; official final records are required after admission.
entries.notes: GRE General is encouraged, not required, for applicants without a Canadian university degree. Do not treat department admission as automatic because a Vector-affiliated professor has expressed interest.

entries.gpa: Standard PhD: appropriate master’s degree with at least B+ across the master’s (U of T 77–79% or 3.3/4.0). Direct-entry PhD: appropriate bachelor’s with at least A− in relevant courses; this route is intended for international students.
entries.english: University English-language proficiency requirements apply. Applicants without a CS degree need substantial CS experience and university mathematics, algorithms and computer-systems preparation.
entries.deadline: 1 December 2026 for Fall 2027 entry. The department states this is a firm deadline, including for Vector Institute applicants.
entries.documents: Three references (at least two addressing graduate research ability), statement of purpose of at most two single-spaced pages, CV, research interests and academic transcripts. Unofficial copies may be used to apply; official final records are required after admission.
entries.notes: GRE General is encouraged, not required, for applicants without a Canadian university degree. Do not treat department admission as automatic because a Vector-affiliated professor has expressed interest.

entries.gpa: Recognized bachelor’s degree or approved equivalent.
entries.english: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with every component at least 5.5; TOEFL iBT 80 before 21 January 2026 or 4.5 on/after that date. Scores must be from one attempt; at-home tests are not accepted. Exemptions include native English or an English-medium bachelor’s degree.
entries.notes: These are Hong Kong-campus minimums. Individual programmes can impose higher or additional requirements; meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission.

entries.gpa: Recognized bachelor’s degree with outstanding performance, or evidence of satisfactory full-time postgraduate study for at least one year (two years part-time).
entries.english: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with every component at least 5.5; TOEFL iBT 80 before 21 January 2026 or 4.5 on/after that date. Scores must be from one attempt; at-home tests are not accepted. Exemptions include native English or an English-medium bachelor’s degree.
entries.notes: These are Hong Kong-campus minimums. Individual programmes can impose higher or additional requirements; meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission.

entries.gpa: High-school diploma or equivalent. Normally submit grades 10–12; special equivalency routes have additional transcript and supplementary-credit rules.
entries.deadline: International-student September 2027 entry: round 1 closes 5 November 2026; round 2 closes 19 January 2027. The overseas-Chinese/Hong Kong/Macau and Mainland routes have separate calendars and eligibility.
entries.documents: Highest qualification certificate and academic transcripts; applicants not yet graduated may provide expected-graduation/enrolment evidence, then the original degree certificate at registration. International applications also require nationality/language evidence, photo, fee/payment evidence, declarations and financial statement; department-specific documents and recommendation-letter counts vary.
entries.notes: These calendars must not be applied to every nationality or admissions route. The February 2027 graduate window closed on 17 September 2026. Programme language rules must be checked individually.

entries.gpa: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, completed before the intended entry semester.
entries.deadline: International-student September 2027 entry: round 1 closes 5 November 2026; round 2 closes 19 January 2027. The overseas-Chinese/Hong Kong/Macau and Mainland routes have separate calendars and eligibility.

International applications also require nationality/language evidence, photo, fee/payment evidence, declarations and financial statement; department-specific documents and recommendation-letter counts vary.

entries.gpa: Master’s degree or equivalent, completed before the intended entry semester.
entries.deadline: International-student September 2027 entry: round 1 closes 5 November 2026; round 2 closes 19 January 2027. The overseas-Chinese/Hong Kong/Macau and Mainland routes have separate calendars and eligibility.

International applications also require nationality/language evidence, photo, fee/payment evidence, declarations and financial statement; department-specific documents and recommendation-letter counts vary.
entries.notes: These calendars must not be applied to every nationality or admissions route. The February 2027 graduate window closed on 17 September 2026. Programme language rules must be checked individually.

entries.gpa: Admission is based on the bachelor’s degree and the specific programme’s requirement profile, academic preparation and performance. Programme-specific GRE, motivation-letter and reference requirements are assessed by the admissions committee.
entries.english: Required teaching-language proof is at C1 level and must be supplied by the application deadline unless a listed exemption applies. English-medium bachelor’s study requires official institutional confirmation. TOEFL/IELTS/ordinary C1 Advanced certificates must be at most two years old.
entries.deadline: Autumn 2027: applicants with a non-Swiss bachelor’s must apply 1–30 November 2026; the official page explicitly states 30 November, 11:59 AM CET. The 1–30 April 2027 window (11:59 AM CEST) is restricted to Swiss bachelor’s degrees. No spring entry.
entries.notes: The published deadline says AM, not midnight; verify this unusual timing on the official page. Holding a later Swiss master’s/PhD does not move a foreign bachelor’s applicant into the April window.

entries.gpa: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent completed before matriculation. A master’s is not required for a GSAS PhD, although some programmes prefer postgraduate preparation.
entries.english: TOEFL or IELTS is necessary for most non-native English speakers; specific exemption and programme testing rules apply. GRE requirements vary by programme.
entries.deadline: Fall 2027 admission deadlines are set separately by each GSAS programme; the university does not assign one common deadline on this page.
entries.documents: Academic statement of purpose, unofficial transcripts from all institutions, three recommendation letters, CV, and USD 105 application fee or waiver. Some programmes require a writing sample or additional materials.
entries.notes: GSAS admissions only. Yale professional-school master’s degrees have separate processes; do not apply this record as a universal Yale requirement.

entries.english: TOEFL or IELTS is necessary for most non-native English speakers; specific exemption and programme testing rules apply. GRE requirements vary by programme.

entries.documents: Academic statement of purpose, unofficial transcripts from all institutions, three recommendation letters, CV, and USD 105 application fee or waiver. Some programmes require a writing sample or additional materials.
entries.notes: GSAS admissions only. Yale professional-school master’s degrees have separate processes; do not apply this record as a universal Yale requirement.

entries.gpa: University bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a related field; selection considers excellent academic records, references, curriculum and specialisation. A second master’s in the same or a closely related field is not permitted. Special Swiss-degree rules are separate.
entries.deadline: Published recurring windows: mid-November to 15 December, or 16 December to 31 March, for September entry. The source does not label these dates with a specific entry year. Visa applicants are strongly advised to use the December deadline.
entries.notes: One master’s programme application per academic year. Individual programme prerequisites may add conditions; the Swiss HES/FHS 5.00 threshold is not a universal foreign-degree minimum.
